title: 第7章 冷清的天庭第8章 玉皇大天尊
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
??注：本书不是封神和洪荒的世界观，所以不存在姜子牙封神一事，神仙需要等到东汉张道陵创立道教，列出神位后开始出现，按照作者设定，这个时候天庭除了三清、四御、五方五老、南斗北斗一些必须存在的神仙外，不会出现其他。）
夜深了。
竹林里的风声渐渐小了下来，虫鸣也稀疏了，天穹上的星子一颗颗亮起来。
猴子练得久了，不知不觉间竟盘腿打起了瞌睡，掌心的火苗忽大忽小，像是也跟着他的呼吸节奏打盹儿。
陶潜拄着拐杖，独自往山巅走去。
伏龙山不高，从竹屋到山顶不过半刻钟路程。陶潜走到山巅一处空地，四下寂静无人，头顶苍穹如盖，银河横亘，北斗七星挂在正北方向，七颗星辰排列成勺状，星光清寒。
他在一块青石上盘膝坐下，周身荡开一层淡青色的荧光，那是鬼仙法力外溢的痕迹。山风拂过，道袍猎猎作响，须发飘飞。
存北斗法的口诀在识海中铺展开来，缓缓闭上了眼。
口诀写得清楚，引北斗星光入体，须先念诵北斗七星君之真名，以真名为媒介，建立修行者与星辰之间的法力通道。七位星君的名号他记得分明。
贪狼、巨门、禄存、文曲、廉贞、武曲、破军。
这些名号他前世就知道，毕竟很多小说内都出现过这几位的名字，所以并不陌生。
只是前世那是几千年前后，如今是春秋时期，这些星君名字恐怕并没有显化于世，不知道有没有用。
这个念头一闪而过，陶潜没有多想。口诀既然给了，照着练便是。
他双手结印，体内法力循经脉运转，开始练咒。
“三尊上真，太玄高神。阳明星主春，万童开门……”
十重天之上，星河浩渺。
天枢宫深处，云雾缭绕，仙气氤氲。大殿内空旷寂寥，只有几根盘龙白玉柱静静矗立。
正在大殿上首打盹的贪狼星君睁开了眼睛。
他听到了一个声音。
那声音极其微弱，缥缈不定，却穿透了人神两界的壁垒，清晰地传入他的耳中。

“阳明星主春……”
贪狼星君豁然起身，目光穿透重重云海，望向下方那广袤的南瞻部洲，只是距离太过遥远，看不真切。
他听出来这是他们北斗七星君的修行法门。
可这怎么可能？
自盘古开天辟地，清气上升浊气下降，他们这些星辰孕育的先天神灵便被困在这星宫之中。
天地间有规矩，神灵欲下界行走，享受人间香火，必须先将真名显化于世。只有凡人知晓了他们的名号，诚心供奉，建立起香火愿力的通道，他们才能借此分出神念，降临人间。
按照天道运转的定数，他们北斗七星的真名，应当在数百年后的东晋时期才会显化。届时自有应劫之人创出北斗法门，教化世人，他们七人方能名正言顺地在人间行走。
可现在，竟然有人提前创出北斗法门，念出了他们的真名！
content_en:
??Note: This book is not a world view of conferring gods and prehistoric times, so there is no such thing as Jiang Ziya conferring gods. Immortals need to wait until Zhang Daoling of the Eastern Han Dynasty founded Taoism and listed the gods to begin to appear. According to the author's setting, at this time, except for the three pure gods, the four emperors, the five directions and the five elders, and the south and north dipper, there will be no other gods that must exist. )
It's late at night.
The sound of wind in the bamboo forest gradually died down, the chirping of insects also became sparse, and the stars in the sky lit up one by one.
The monkey had been practicing for a long time, and he unconsciously dozed off with his legs crossed. The flames in his palms waxed and waned, as if he was dozing with the rhythm of his breathing.
Tao Qian walked to the top of the mountain alone on crutches.
Fulong Mountain is not high, and it only takes half a quarter of an hour to reach the top of the mountain from the bamboo house. Tao Qian walked to an open space on the top of the mountain. There was no one around. The sky above his head was like a canopy, the Milky Way stretched across it, and the Big Dipper hung due north. The seven stars were arranged in a spoon shape, and the starlight was cold.
He sat cross-legged on a piece of bluestone, and a layer of light blue fluorescence spread around his body, which was the trace of the magic power of ghosts and immortals overflowing. The mountain breeze blew by, the Taoist robes rustled, and the beard and hair flew.
The formula for saving the Beidou method spread out in the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and he slowly closed his eyes.
The formula is clearly written. To attract the light of the Big Dipper into the body, one must first recite the true name of the Big Dipper Lord, and use the true name as the medium to establish a magical channel between the practitioner and the stars. He clearly remembered the names of the seven star kings.
Greedy Wolf, Jumen, Lucun, Wenqu, Lianzhen, Wuqu, Pojun.
He knew these names from his previous life. After all, these names appeared in many novels, so they were no strangers to them.
It's just that the previous life was thousands of years ago, and now it's the Spring and Autumn Period. I'm afraid these Xingjun names have not been manifested in the world, and I don't know if they are useful.
This thought flashed past, and Tao Qian didn't think much about it. Since the formula is given, just practice accordingly.
He formed a seal with his hands, and the magic power in his body circulated through his meridians, and he began to practice the mantra.
"Three Shangzhen, Taixuan Gao Shen. Yangxing controls spring, Wantong opens the door..."
Above the tenth heaven, the stars are vast.
Deep in Tianshu Palace, clouds and mist are lingering, and the fairy spirit is dense. The main hall is empty and lonely, with only a few coiled dragon white jade pillars standing quietly.
Tanlang Xingjun, who was taking a nap in the main hall, opened his eyes.
He heard a voice.
The sound was extremely weak and ethereal, but it penetrated the barrier between the human and divine worlds and reached his ears clearly.
"Yangxing Zhuchun..."
Greedy Wolf Star Lord suddenly stood up, looking through the sea of clouds and looking at the vast Nanzhan Continent below, but the distance was too far to see clearly.
He heard that this was their Big Dipper Master's practice method.
But how is this possible?
Since the creation of the world by Pangu, the clear air has risen and the dirty air has fallen. They, the innate gods born from the stars, have been trapped in this star palace.
There are rules in heaven and earth. If a spirit wants to travel down to the lower world and enjoy the incense of the world, it must first manifest its true name into the world. Only when mortals know their names, worship them sincerely, and establish a channel for incense and aspiration, can they use this to separate their spiritual thoughts and come to the world.
According to the destiny of heaven, the true names of their Big Dipper should not be revealed until the Eastern Jin Dynasty hundreds of years later. At that time, someone who deserves the calamity will create the Beidou Dharma and teach the world, and then the seven of them can walk in the world with integrity.
But now, someone actually created the Beidou method in advance and pronounced their real names!
